bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Follower is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve test to continue fighting.

bonuses.name: Simple Automata
bonuses.text: The Follower can only perform simple actions—navigating an environment, picking up or dropping off small objects—without direct instruction from its operator.

bonuses.name: Surveillance
bonuses.text: The Follower sends a constant feed of everything it sees and hears back to its operator, who may view them on a control device, or via armour autosenses or a data-tether.

bonuses.name: Tracked
bonuses.text: This Follower moves on a set of segmented tracks. It cannot jump, climb, or traverse any obstacle taller than half its height.
